reviews.title: Beyond my expectations!
reviews.text: From counter staff to crew, very nice service! Iam positive to say that would be necessary something very atractive to choose another airline in the near future for the same route. Congrats you guys!!!
reviews.author: Jonny Simões

reviews.title: Best Choice if They Serve Your Destination
reviews.text: A fabulous, efficient airline! The only drawback is they don't yet serve more destinations (being a newer airline). The smaller planes, Embraer ERJ-170s and 175s, seat around 78 people, so boarding, and disembarking is pretty quick. Love them!
reviews.author: steveP3242IL

reviews.title: Flying into Komaki Airport
reviews.text: I really did not know about the airline until I was looking for a flight from Fukuoka to Nagoya. It’s well known for its colourful bodies. Small Ember was light and smooth. Flight experiences were rather comfortable. The only issue was getting a ticket. I bought the ticket from JAL but I had to keep asking airline’s ground stuff where I could get a boarding pass. I should be able to pick up from JAL as I bought it from JAL’s code share.
reviews.author: NYLON_nomad

reviews.title: great!
reviews.text: If they serve the destination I need to go, they are my preferred airline. It's wonderful to use smaller airports. From arrival to airport, check-in, security, and boarding, it's a quick, no-hassle process.
reviews.author: steveP3242IL

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Service was friendly baggage claim great up stai,r s seats fun and roomy no problems food was ok not short off drinks as well we just had a really great experience on that flight

reviews.title: Holiday 50th birthday
reviews.text: Everything was good and on time boarded plane and due to snow we was sat on plane for 4hours they had to keep de icing so we missed slots each time that's fine for everyone's safety but the staff were not friendly especially one steward in particular the flight was 13 hours we had one coffee and one meal they ran out no apologys one women asked for atomic water the steward said there was none but I heard the hostess say there was out back but he said he wasn't going to get any horrible man but coming home couldn't fault flight staff were different plenty of food and drink
reviews.author: paula j

reviews.title: Fuji Dream Airlines Experience
reviews.text: I had enjoyed the flight with FDA from Sapporo to Matsumoto with the E175STD - Economy seat. Even though the aircraft size is small, but i enjoyed pretty much the atmosphere, and the leg room space. There cabin crew members were extremely professional and friendly.
